text: Artificial intelligence is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, from sorting emails to checking data, which saves workers time. Productivity tools powered by AI help employees write reports, schedule meetings, and find information quickly. Instead of replacing people completely, AI often works alongside humans. This human-AI collaboration allows staff to focus on creative and complex problems while machines deal with routine work. However, jobs are changing. Some roles disappear, while new ones appear, and many workers need training to use these tools well. Overall, AI can make work faster and more efficient, but success depends on how people adapt to these changes.
